Want to pick up an entire room and move it somewhere else? §6Spatial Storage §fdoes exactly that.

Build a frame of §6Spatial Pylons §fdefining a region from 2x2x2 up to 128x128x128. Place a §6Spatial IO Port §fon the structure, insert a Spatial Storage Cell, and the entire region gets sampled into the cell. Move the cell to another Spatial IO Port and the region rebuilds.

It is like copy-paste for the physical world. Walls, machines, chests with items, everything.

Craft Spatial Pylons from Quartz Glass, Fluix Cables, Fluix Dust, and Fluix Crystals.

§cWARNING:§f Power draw scales with region volume. A 128x128x128 region will drain your energy cells fast. Plan your power supply accordingly.

§ePS:§f Each pylon emits light to show the region boundaries. Use that to verify your frame before activating.
